The Story Behind BAYA
MEET BAYANI
A Little Eagle, A Big Hope
Part 2 of 4
Bayani’s parents are Dakila and Sinag. The Philippine Eagle Foundation helps breed and care for eagles like Bayani. Philippine eagles are critically endangered: very few remain, and they need protection.
Bayani was introduced to the public on March 10, 2026. Adopter Nico Herth chose the name. Bayani’s birth brings hope to the people working to protect Philippine eagles.
